Home.heading: Cad Studio
Home.heroSubtitle: Event, wedding, portrait and product photography — planned with care, delivered with style. Toronto-based, available worldwide.
Home.categoriesIntro: Choose a service to see packages and starting prices.
Home.introStatement: The light, the laughter, <accent>the people</accent> who made it matter.
Home.introBody: Cad Studio is led by I. Rukshan, a photographer with more than ten years behind the lens and a background in event management. That means calm, organized coverage: we know the run-of-show, we're where the moments happen, and nothing important is missed.
Home.whyTitle: Planned like an event, <accent>shot</accent> like a story
Home.whyIntro: Experience behind the camera and behind the scenes.
Home.whyExperienceBody: A decade of weddings, corporate events, portraits and product work — and the judgement that comes with it.
Home.whyPlanningBody: We understand timelines, venues and vendors, so coverage stays smooth and unobtrusive on the day.
Home.whyReachBody: Based in Scarborough, Toronto. Serving the GTA, Canada-wide, and travelling worldwide.
Home.portfolioIntro: A few recent projects, near and far.

About.metaDescription: Meet I. Rukshan, founder and lead photographer of Cad Studio — 10+ years behind the lens with a background in event management.
About.title: Behind the <accent>lens</accent>
About.intro: Cad Studio — Collection Art Design — is a photography studio based in Scarborough, Toronto, founded by I. Rukshan.
About.ownerBody: I. Rukshan has spent more than ten years behind the camera, photographing weddings, corporate events, family celebrations, portraits and products. Alongside photography, Rukshan brings hands-on experience in event management — planning, coordination and running the day itself.
About.approachIntro: Knowing how an event runs means knowing where to be before the moment happens.
About.approachPlanBody: Before the day, we review your timeline and key moments so coverage is mapped to your schedule, not improvised.
About.approachFlowBody: Entrances, speeches, first dances, awards — we anticipate each cue and are in position when it happens.
About.approachCalmBody: Working with planners, venues and vendors comes naturally, so we capture the day without getting in its way.
About.areasBody: Based in Scarborough and serving the Greater Toronto Area, with coverage across Canada and travel for destination events around the world.
About.ctaBody: Share a few details and we'll be in touch.
